title: Pac-Man (Ghost AI)
summary: Ghost-mode AI as nested state machines — four ghosts each running the same FSM, with HSM-inherited frighten handling and a top-level mode cycle.
teaches: HSM ghost modes · $OutOfPen parent · Scatter/Chase/Frightened/Eaten · two push$/pop$ scales
controls: Arrows move · grab the pellet to frighten the ghost · P pause · SPACE start/restart

machines.title: GhostGame — the orchestrator
machines.blurb: The phase clock for the whole arena. Idle waits for start; then the global mode cycles Scatter ⇄ Chase on a tick timer. Grabbing the power pellet is push$/pop$ at the GAME scale: from either Scatter or Chase, push$ stashes the current global mode and transitions to Frightened; when the frighten timer expires, pop$ returns to whichever was active so the cycle picks up where it left off.

machines.title: Ghost — HSM + per-ghost frighten subroutine
machines.blurb: Each of the four ghosts runs this same parameterized machine independently (Blinky / Pinky / Inky / Clyde with different home corners and target kinds); the diagram tracks the first one. OutOfPen is the HSM parent — Chase and Scatter inherit its frighten handler, so power_pellet_eaten works in either child. push$ stashes the current OutOfPen child; pop$ returns to it after frighten expires. Eaten is the death-and-return-to-pen detour.

machines.title: GhostPen
machines.blurb: The home cage. Single-state system that owns the release schedule and pen reset; the orchestrator routes release / arrival events here, and individual ghosts move InPen ⇄ OutOfPen ⇄ Eaten in response.
